svg.text: You are welcome here, whatever you came for. If you want sharper thinking commands in
your Claude Code sessions, start with Install: one line, and rdc uninstall undoes every
byte of it. If you came to check whether the numbers on this page are real, start with
Verify and try to break them; that is the point of the page, not an offence against it.
If "DTD" is a word you last saw in 2002, nothing here requires you to write one: the
commands work as commands, and the grammar rides inside them.
Questions that begin "this is probably a dumb question" are the ones the documentation
failed to answer. Ask them in Discussions and they will be treated as defects in this
